settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure your application preferences and settings
settings.autoRefreshSettingsDescription: Configure automatic price updates for your portfolio
settings.refreshIntervalWarning: Shorter intervals may increase API usage
settings.refreshIntervalNote: Auto-refresh can be toggled on/off from the Dashboard using the lightning bolt button. Prices will also refresh automatically when you switch back to the tab.
settings.dailyChangeNotificationsDescription: Get notified when your holdings experience significant daily price movements (automatically calculated based on asset volatility)
settings.enableDailyChangeNotificationsInfo: Receive notifications when any of your holdings moves significantly. Thresholds are automatically set based on asset type (3% for mega-cap, 5% for mid-cap, 8% for crypto, etc.)
settings.notificationThresholdNote: The system automatically sets smart thresholds based on asset characteristics: mega-cap stocks (3%), large-cap (4%), mid-cap (5%), small-cap (7%), micro-cap (10%), crypto (8%), and ETFs (4%). This ensures you're notified about truly significant moves without alert fatigue.
settings.transactionNotificationsDescription: Get notified about transaction activity in your portfolios
settings.enableTransactionNotificationsInfo: Receive notifications when transactions are added, edited, or deleted in your portfolios
settings.enableTransactionNotificationsNote: Transaction notifications help you track all portfolio activity, including new purchases, sales, dividends, and any modifications to existing transactions.
settings.dailyPortfolioReportsDescription: Receive a comprehensive daily PDF report of your portfolio performance
settings.enableDailyPortfolioReportsInfo: Get a beautiful PDF report emailed to you every weekday at 4 PM ET (after market close)
settings.enableDailyPortfolioReportsNote: Your daily report contains portfolio metrics, a visual heatmap of all positions, holdings with P&L, and transaction activity. Reports are sent Monday-Friday at 4:00 PM Eastern Time when markets close.
settings.athAtlNotificationsDescription: Get notified when your holdings reach new all-time highs or lows
settings.enableAthAtlNotificationsInfo: Receive notifications when any asset you hold reaches a new all-time high (ATH) 🚀 or all-time low (ATL) 📉
settings.athAtlNotificationsNote: Be the first to know when your holdings make history by reaching unprecedented price levels, whether positive or negative.
settings.pushNotificationsDescription: Receive push notifications on your phone or desktop even when the app is closed
settings.pushNotificationsNotSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser. Try using Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari on a supported device.
settings.pushNotificationsActive: Push notifications are enabled on this device
settings.pushNotificationsDenied: Permission was blocked - check your browser settings
settings.pushNotificationsInactive: Push notifications are not enabled on this device
settings.testNotificationSent: Test notification sent! You should receive it shortly.
settings.testNotificationFailed: Failed to send test notification. Make sure push is enabled.
settings.pushNotificationsEnabled: Push notifications enabled! You'll now receive alerts on this device.
settings.pushNotificationsDisabled: Push notifications disabled on this device.
settings.pushNotificationsDeniedMessage: Permission denied. Please allow notifications in your browser settings.
settings.pushNotificationsNote: Push notifications are sent to this device when you have significant portfolio changes, price alerts, or other important updates. You can enable push on multiple devices.
settings.validateSellQuantitiesDescription: When enabled, you cannot sell more shares than you currently own. Disable this for historical data imports or short selling.
settings.validateSellQuantitiesDescription1: Changes to this setting take effect immediately but are not persisted across server restarts. To make permanent changes, update the
settings.dangerZoneDescription: This will permanently delete all portfolios, transactions, prices, and assets. This action cannot be undone.
settings.projectDescription: A modern investment portfolio tracker built with FastAPI and React. Track your stocks, ETFs, and crypto with real-time pricing, P&L analytics, and beautiful charts.
settings.features2: Real-time price tracking via Yahoo Finance
